text:
Faye: dropped two desktop mocks for billing rows: 'compact-grid' (tight rows, inline sparkline) vs 'action-cards' (each invoice shows Download/Pay/Note). need quick takes before PM review.
Ibrahim: link?
Faye: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-rows-compare
Clara: compact-grid is great for scanning; but the Download action is buried in a 3-dot menu which might confuse customers looking for invoices.
Noah: action-cards make actions explicit but increase vertical scroll. mobile could be painful.
a11y-bot: flagged: compact-grid uses token shorthand ("2.3k") which VoiceOver reads awkwardly. recommend aria-label with full number. also overdue badge contrast in dark theme is 3.6:1.
Ibrahim: what if we show a tiny inline "Pay" only for overdue and keep Download in overflow for all rows? reduces accidental payments and surfaces urgency.
Clara: +1. also propose adding a micro-sparkline in compact-grid (non-interactive) for trend context. include aria-label like "Usage trend last 30 days: increasing".
Faye: ok will update: aria-labels for token shorthand, bump badge contrast to >=4.5:1, add optional sparklines, and make expand chevron keyboard-focusable (Enter toggles).
Noah: UX nit: when Pay is inline show a 2-step confirm (tiny modal) and mark the action as primary destructive to avoid mistakes.
a11y-bot: also ensure chevrons have visible focus ring and tabindex order includes them between checkbox and overflow menu.
Faye: noted. I'll upload revised mocks tonight and propose a small AB: 30% compact+sparkline, 30% action-cards, 40% control. we'll track invoice downloads, pay completes, support mentions "invoice", and avg rows expanded.
Ibrahim: sounds good. anything else?
Clara: none from design.
Noah: none from payments infra.
Faye: cool, adding to tomorrow's review (10m). ping me for any last-minute a11y issues. :thumbsup:
